campaignevents-rest-enable-registration-: Looma oggola inaad hawlgeliso diiwaangelinta dhacdooyinka.
campaignevents-rest-edit-page-nonlocal: Diiwaangelinta dhacdadan waxaa laga hawlgeliyey wiki-ga soo socda, waana in halkaas lagu tafatiro: $1.
campaignevents-rest-delete-already-delet: Diiwaangelintan dhacdada hore ayaa loo tirtiray.
campaignevents-rest-user-not-found: Ma jiro isticmaale leh aqoonsigan dhexe.
campaignevents-rest-remove-participants-: Halbeegga 'user_ids' waa inuu noqdaa liis aqoonsiyo isticmaalayaal ah, ama waa inuu noqdaa madhan (si looga saaro dhammaan isticmaalayaasha)
Fadlan ka saar ka qaybgalayaasha ee $1, oo ah wiki-ga lagu abuuray dhacdada.
campaignevents-rest-list-participants-em: Shaandhada magaca isticmaalaha, haddii la cayimay, waa inay noqotaa qoraal aan madhnayn.
campaignevents-rest-list-participants-ca: Looma oggola inaad aragto ka qaybgalayaasha si gaar ah isu diiwaangeliyey dhacdadan.
campaignevents-rest-set-organizers-empty: <var>organizer_usernames</var> waa inuu noqdaa liis magacyada isticmaalayaasha ah, mana noqon karo madhan
campaignevents-rest-set-organizers-nonlo: Fadlan ku xadid qabanqaabiyayaasha $1, oo ah wiki-ga lagu abuuray dhacdada.
campaignevents-rest-register-invalid-ans: Jawaabta su'aasha $1 ma aha mid sax ah
campaignevents-rest-register-for-event-n: Fadlan ku dhammaystir diiwaangelintaada dhacdada ee $1, oo ah wiki-ga lagu abuuray dhacdada.
campaignevents-rest-delete-event-nonloca: Fadlan tirtir diiwaangelintaada dhacdada ee $1, oo ah wiki-ga lagu abuuray dhacdada.
campaignevents-rest-email-participants-n: Fadlan iimayl u dir ka qaybgalayaasha ee $1, oo ah wiki-ga lagu abuuray dhacdada.
campaignevents-rest-contribution-not-fou: Ma jiro wax ku biirin leh aqoonsigan.
campaignevents-rest-delete-contribution-: Looma oggola inaad tirtirto wax ku biirintan.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-contribut: Aqoonsiga tiro ee diiwaanka ka qaybgalka dhacdada ee la tirtirayo.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-userid: Aqoonsiga isticmaale ee dhexe ee caalamiga ah ee isticmaalaha.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-event-pag: Cinwaanka bogga dhacdadan ee wikiga maxalliga ah.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-timezone: Aqoonsiga aagga waqtiga ee wakhtiyada dhacdada, qaab kasta oo ay aqbasho DateTimeZone ee PHP.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-start-tim: Waqtiga bilowga dhacdada ee qaabka shaambadda waqtiga MediaWiki (YYYYMMDDHHmmss), oo ku salaysan aagga waqtiga lagu qeexay xuduudaha timezone.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-end-time: Waqtiga dhammaadka dhacdada ee qaabka shaambadda waqtiga MediaWiki (YYYYMMDDHHmmss), oo ku salaysan aagga waqtiga lagu qeexay xuduudaha timezone.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-types: Hal ama in ka badan oo aqoonsiyada nooca dhacdada ah. Ugu badnaan 2 qiime.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-wikis: Wikiyada la xiriira dhacdadan. Gudbi ["*"] si loogu daro dhammaan wikiyada. Ugu badnaan 100 qiime.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-topics: Mawduucyada la xiriira dhacdadan. Ugu badnaan 5 qiime.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-online-me: In dhacdadu leedahay qayb kulan onlayn ah.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-inperson-: In dhacdadu leedahay qayb kulan fool ka fool ah.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-meeting-u: URL-ka kulanka onlaynka ah. Waxaa arki kara oo keliya qabanqaabiyeyaasha iyo ka qaybgalayaasha haysta rukhsadaha ku habboon.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-meeting-c: Koodhka waddanka ee CLDR ee goobta kulanka fool ka foolka ah.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-meeting-a: Cinwaanka waddada ee goobta kulanka fool ka foolka ah.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-chat-url: URL-ka kanaalka wada sheekaysiga dhacdada. Waxaa arki kara oo keliya qabanqaabiyeyaasha iyo ka qaybgalayaasha haysta rukhsadaha ku habboon.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-is-test-e: In tani tahay dhacdo tijaabo ah. Dhacdooyinka tijaabada ah laguma daro tirakoobka.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-tracks-co: In dhacdadani la socoto wax ka qabadyada wiki ee la sameeyo inta lagu jiro muddada dhacdada.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-goal-type: Nooca cabbirka loo isticmaalo in lagu cabbiro yoolka dhacdada.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-goal-targ: Qiimaha bartilmaameedka ee yoolka dhacdada (ugu yaraan 1).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-tracking-: Aqoonsiga aaladda dabagalka dibadda. Qiimaha keliya ee hadda la taageero waa "wikimedia-pe-dashboard", oo loogu talagalay Dashboard-ka Barnaamijyada iyo Dhacdooyinka (https://outreachdashboard.wmflabs.org/).
Aqoonsiga dhacdada ee ku dhex jira aaladda dabagalka dibadda. Dashboard-ka Barnaamijyada iyo Dhacdooyinka, tani waa slug-ka koorsada ee URL-ka dashboard-ka (waddada ka dambaysa /courses/).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-is-privat: In loo diiwaangeliyo ka qaybgalaha gaarka ah. Diiwaangelinta gaarka ah uma muuqato ka qaybgalayaasha kale.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-show-cont: In loo muujiyo ka qaybgalahan weydiinta xiriirinta wax ka qabadka kadib wax ka beddelka.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-answers: Jawaabaha su'aalaha ka qaybgalaha, oo ah shay ay furaha kasta yahay magaca su'aasha, qiime kastaana yahay shay leh furaha "value" (xulashada la doortay) iyo furaha ikhtiyaariga ah ee "other" (gelinta qoraalka xorta ah ee xulashada la doortay).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-last-orga: Aqoonsiga qabanqaabiyaha ee natiijadii ugu dambaysay ee boggii hore, ee bogsiinta ku salaysan calaamadda.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-organizer: Liiska magacyada isticmaalayaasha loo dejinayo qabanqaabiyeyaal. Wuxuu gebi ahaanba beddelayaa liiska qabanqaabiyeyaasha hadda jira.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-include-p: In lagu daro ka qaybgalayaasha si gaar ah isu diiwaangeliyey. Waxay u baahan tahay rukhsadaha qabanqaabiyaha.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-last-part: Aqoonsiga ka qaybgalaha ee natiijadii ugu dambaysay ee boggii hore, ee bogsiinta ku salaysan calaamadda.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-username-: Shaandhee ka qaybgalayaasha magacooda isticmaaluhu uu ku jiro xargahan.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-exclude-u: Liiska aqoonsiyada isticmaalayaasha dhexe ee laga saarayo natiijooyinka.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-remove-pa: Aqoonsiyada isticmaalayaasha dhexe ee la saarayo. Gudbi null si loo bartilmaameedsado dhammaan ka qaybgalayaasha (isticmaal la socda invert_users).
Haddii ay run tahay, ka saar dhammaan ka qaybgalayaasha marka laga reebo kuwa ku jira user_ids.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-email-use: Aqoonsiyada isticmaalayaasha dhexe ee lagu darayo ama laga saarayo (iyadoo ku xiran invert_users).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-email-inv: Haddii ay run tahay, iimayl u dir dhammaan ka qaybgalayaasha marka laga reebo kuwa ku jira user_ids.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-email-mes: Qoraalka jirka iimaylka, qoraal saafi ah oo keliya.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-ccme: In nuqul iimaylka ah loo diro diraha.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-question-: Ku xaddid natiijooyinka su'aalaha leh aqoonsiyadan. Waxay soo celisaa dhammaan su'aalaha haddii la iska dhaafo.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-language-: Koodhka luqadda loo isticmaalo qaabaynta wakhtiyada, qaabka ay MediaWiki gudaha ugu isticmaasho (oo la mid ah BCP 47 balse leh kala duwanaansho).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-start-tim: Shaambadda waqtiga bilowga oo ah qaab kasta oo uu aqbalo falanqayaha shaambadda waqtiga ee MediaWiki.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-end-times: Shaambadda waqtiga dhammaadka oo ah qaab kasta oo uu aqbalo falanqayaha shaambadda waqtiga ee MediaWiki.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-wiki: Aqoonsiga wikiga dib u eegista lagu sameeyay.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-revid: Aqoonsiga dib u eegista ee wikiga bartilmaameedka.
campaignevents-rest-patch-worklist-title: Cinwaanka liiska shaqada waa inuusan ka koobnaan horgale interwiki ama qayb ka mid ah bogga.
campaignevents-rest-response-registratio: Diiwaangelinta dhacdada lama helin ama waa la tirtiray.
campaignevents-rest-response-email-accep: Hawsha dirista iimaylka waa la aqbalay. Tirada la diray waxay ka tarjumaysaa iimayllada la diray.
campaignevents-rest-response-contributio: Hawsha isku xirka wax ku biirinta waa la aqbalay.
Diiwaanka wax ku biirinta dhacdada waa la tirtiray.
